title: GroupOwnershipContent
description: Content item with access control details for a group.

content_guid.description: The unique identifier of the content item.

content_name.description: The name of the content item.

content_title.description: The title of the content item.

access_type.description: The access type of the content item.

permissions.description:
List of principals (users and groups) with access to the content.
The owner is listed as `author` and is always present.

GroupOwnershipPermission.description: A principal with access to a content item.

principal_guid.description: The identifier of the principal (user or group) with access to the content.

principal_name.description: The name of the principal (user or group) with access to the content.

principal_role.description: The role of the principal (user or group) with access to the content.

principal_type.description: The type of the principal (user or group) with access to the content.
